summary: Iteration 3 testing of NIB QR-code verification (oss.go.id decode + registry SIMULASI) and BRIAPI bank name-check (SIMULASI). Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_nib_qr_bank.py — 12/13 new tests pass. Frontend Playwright: verified verify-nib-upload → nib-check-result shows 'QR: TERDETEKSI · Domain oss.go.id: VALID · NIB cocok: YA · Registry OSS: SIMULASI · AKTIF' and bank-check-result shows 'Status: VERIFIED · Sumber: SIMULASI · Nama sesuai bank: <legal> · Kecocokan: 100%'. Toasts 'QR NIB terverifikasi' and 'Nama pemilik rekening cocok' visible. REGRESSION FOUND: bank verify SIMULASI mode cannot produce mismatch because verify_bank() computes sim = max(sim(resolved,legal), sim(resolved,brand), sim(resolved,holder)) and in SIMULASI mode resolved_name = holder, so sim(holder,holder)=1.0 always → verified=true regardless of legal_name. This breaks the intended SIMULASI check of comparing declared holder to company name, and also causes iter2's existing test_bank_verification_mismatch to fail. Fix: remove holder from the max() (or only compare resolved vs {legal, brand}).

critical.issue: SIMULASI bank name-check always returns verified=true. In SIMULASI branch, resolved_name is set to declared holder, and _name_similarity(resolved, holder) is included in max() → always 1.0. Mismatch scenario (holder unrelated to legal_name) is unreachable, breaking the stated behaviour 'SIMULASI mode comparing declared account holder name to the company name'. Also fails prior iter2 test TestValidNibSlaQueue::test_bank_verification_mismatch (previously passing).

action_items: server.py verify_bank(): change 'sim = max(_name_similarity(resolved, legal), _name_similarity(resolved, brand), _name_similarity(resolved, holder))' to 'sim = max(_name_similarity(resolved, legal), _name_similarity(resolved, brand))' so SIMULASI (where resolved==holder) meaningfully compares holder-vs-company. Re-run iter2 test test_bank_verification_mismatch to confirm; add a new test where legal='PT ABC' and holder='John Doe' expects verified=false.
critical_code_review_comments: verify_bank max() logic (server.py:379) — includes holder in similarity max, making SIMULASI mismatch impossible (see critical bug).

rca of the issue: verify_bank() SIMULASI mismatch bug — RCA: In SIMULASI branch (line ~376), code assigns `resolved = holder` because BRIAPI is not configured. Then similarity is computed as sim = max(sim(resolved,legal), sim(resolved,brand), sim(resolved,holder)). The third term is sim(holder,holder) = 1.0 always, making the max always ≥ 0.5, so status is always 'verified'. Reproduction: legal_name='TEST_PT Anything', bank_account_holder='Totally Unrelated Zzz' → verify_bank returns verified=true, name_match_score=100. Expected: verified=false, name_match_score < 50, status='mismatch'. Mitigation: drop 'holder' from the max() in the SIMULASI code path — or equivalently, only include holder when BRIAPI actually returned an independent account_name (i.e., always compare resolved-vs-company for the source-agnostic score).
